contract_version.description: Version label of docs/api-contract.md this build implements.
contract_version.title: Contract Version

implemented_endpoint_count.description: Number of routes this build actually serves. Exposed so a caller can tell a scaffold apart from a complete implementation without guessing.
implemented_endpoint_count.title: Implemented Endpoint Count

unimplemented_capabilities.description: Capabilities the contract describes but this build does not implement. Reported explicitly so nothing silently pretends to work.
unimplemented_capabilities.title: Unimplemented Capabilities

AuditEventResponse.description:
One append-only audit event.

``before``/``after`` are safe diffs: they contain the fields that changed and
never raw receipt content, OCR text or credentials.

correlation_id.description: Ties this event to the request that caused it and to the server log line.
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

AuditEventResponse.title: AuditEventResponse

CreateExpenseRequest.description:
Create a draft claim from JSON metadata.

Receipt images are uploaded separately through
``POST /api/v1/expenses/{expense_id}/receipts`` - the single canonical upload
route. This request deliberately carries no ``source`` or ``reviewed``
fields: provenance is assigned by the server from the caller's role, so a
client cannot claim reviewer provenance.

employee_membership_id.description: Only accepted from a caller authorized to create on behalf of another employee. An employee's own claims are always created against their own membership.
employee_membership_id.title: Employee Membership Id

CreateExpenseRequest.title: CreateExpenseRequest

dataset.description: Identifier of the synthetic fixture set that was loaded.
dataset.title: Dataset

policy_rules_activated.description: Always 0. The seed never activates a policy rule, because no source policy document has been supplied and a rule cannot be activated without a verified clause.
policy_rules_activated.title: Policy Rules Activated

synthetic.description: Always true. No real receipt or employee data is ever seeded.
synthetic.title: Synthetic

DerivationType.description: How a derived receipt object relates to its parent.
DerivationType.title: DerivationType

DraftExpenseResponse.description: Minimal response needed to attach a receipt to an employee-owned draft.
DraftExpenseResponse.title: DraftExpenseResponse

enums.title: Enums

ExpenseChannel.description:
How a claim entered the system.

``EMAIL_SIMULATED`` is demo-only and must never be presented as a real
email integration.
ExpenseChannel.title: ExpenseChannel

ExpenseStatus.description:
Workflow status of an expense claim.

Deliberately NOT used to represent individual findings: a claim can carry
many findings while holding exactly one workflow status.

``WITHDRAWN`` is reserved. No endpoint currently produces it; see
docs/api-contract.md section 5 for the explanation.
ExpenseStatus.title: ExpenseStatus

components.description: Per-dependency status keyed by a stable component name.

job_grade_name.description: Grade label only. Never used by a client to infer an allowance: the effective allowance comes from the resolved policy assignment.

info.description: Evidence-first expense auditing API. This build supports authorized draft creation, private receipt upload and persisted asynchronous extraction runs. Raw OCR/model text is not retained. Production authentication, policy evaluation and review workflows remain incomplete. GET /api/v1/meta lists the outstanding capabilities.
info.title: Proofline API

post.description: The contract describes this route for demoing a cross-channel duplicate. It is not implemented, and it must never be presented as a real email integration.

schema.title: Response Simulate Email Import Api V1 Demo Import Email Post

post.description: Deletes the fixed demo organization and demo-provider users. Non-demo data is not reachable from this operation. Audit events are append-only and survive the reset; the reset itself is recorded as an audit event.
post.summary: Remove only the synthetic demo dataset (demo mode only)

post.description: Loads deterministic, clearly labelled synthetic data: one fictional organization, fictional people, memberships, role grants and reporting edges, plus an unapproved and empty policy version. Creates no policy rules and no allowance limits, because both require real organizational data and a verified policy clause.
post.summary: Load the synthetic demo dataset (demo mode only)

post.description: Creates a draft for the caller's active membership so a receipt can be attached. This workflow slice does not support creating claims for another employee.

schema.title: Response List Expense Receipts Api V1 Expenses  Expense Id  Receipts Get

get.summary: List authorized receipts and extraction runs for an expense

post.description: Uploads one original receipt to a caller-owned draft, validates its content and persists a pending extraction run for background processing. Exact duplicate files remain separate receipts and are linked only by their SHA-256 signal.

415.description: The file content is not an accepted receipt format.

post.summary: Upload a private receipt and queue extraction

post.description: Stores each validated receipt and creates its own persisted pending extraction run. A batch is limited to 20 files; each receipt is processed independently.

schema.title: Response Upload Receipt Batch Api V1 Expenses  Expense Id  Receipts Batch Post

post.summary: Upload a batch of up to 20 independent receipts

get.description: Reports service health, the database probe result and the status of each dependency. Contains no secrets, no connection strings and no stack traces. Unauthenticated by design so a load balancer can reach it.

Resolves the caller's own organization membership. The actor is derived from the validated identity and server-side role grants; nothing about identity, role or scope is taken from the request body or query string.
An employee may read their own audit trail. Reading another actor's trail requires a scoped review permission and is not exposed here.
get.summary: Audit events attributed to the authenticated actor

get.description: Returns the caller's own non-revoked role grants with the scope each applies to. Granted only through organization memberships; a client cannot request someone else's grants, because the membership is taken from the validated identity.

schema.title: Response Read My Roles Api V1 Me Roles Get

get.summary: The authenticated actor's own role grants

get.description: Contract version, implemented endpoint count and the list of capabilities the contract describes but this build does not implement.

Every enumerated value in the canonical contract, keyed by the name used in docs/api-contract.md. Clients must not invent local alternatives; a divergence between a client's list and this endpoint is a bug.

get.summary: Read authorized receipt metadata and OCR status

get.description: The endpoint rechecks receipt and expense authorization on every request.

post.description: Appends a new extraction run for a receipt owned by the caller. Previous run results are preserved and never overwritten.
post.summary: Retry extraction for an authorized receipt
